items.text: A finance business partner sits with a business team, explains the numbers, challenges assumptions and helps leaders decide, and the path usually runs through accounting or FP&A, then a business unit, and needs both modelling skill and comfortable communication.
Learn reporting and forecasting first, then learn one business well enough to question its numbers.
Proof you can show supports an earlier path to financial freedom.
